entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:1
segments: Dead flies cause the oil of the perfumer to send forth an evil odor; [so] doth a little folly outweigh wisdom and honor.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:2
segments: A wise man's heart is at his right hand; but a fool's heart at his left.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:3
segments: Yea also, when the fool walketh by the way, his understanding faileth him, and he saith to every one [that] he is a fool.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:4
segments: If the spirit of the ruler rise up against thee, leave not thy place; for gentleness allayeth great offences.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:5
segments: There is an evil which I have seen under the sun, as it were an error which proceedeth from the ruler:

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:6
segments: folly is set in great dignity, and the rich sit in a low place.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:7
segments: I have seen servants upon horses, and princes walking like servants upon the earth.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:8
segments: He that diggeth a pit shall fall into it; and whoso breaketh through a wall, a serpent shall bite him.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:9
segments: Whoso heweth out stones shall be hurt therewith; [and] he that cleaveth wood is endangered thereby.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:10
segments: If the iron be blunt, and one do not whet the edge, then must he put to more strength: but wisdom is profitable to direct.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:11
segments: If the serpent bite before it is charmed, then is there no advantage in the charmer.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:12
segments: The words of a wise man's mouth are gracious; but the lips of a fool will swallow up himself.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:13
segments: The beginning of the words of his mouth is foolishness; and the end of his talk is mischievous madness.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:14
segments: A fool also multiplieth words: [yet] man knoweth not what shall be; and that which shall be after him, who can tell him?

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:15
segments: The labor of fools wearieth every one of them; for he knoweth not how to go to the city.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:16
segments: Woe to thee, O land, when thy king is a child, and thy princes eat in the morning!

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:17
segments: Happy art thou, O land, when thy king is the son of nobles, and thy princes eat in due season, for strength, and not for drunkenness!

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:18
segments: By slothfulness the roof sinketh in; and through idleness of the hands the house leaketh.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:19
segments: A feast is made for laughter, and wine maketh glad the life; and money answereth all things.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:20
segments: Revile not the king, no, not in thy thought; and revile not the rich in thy bedchamber: for a bird of the heavens shall carry the voice, and that which hath wings shall tell the matter.
